payload.body_content:
Hi J,

I reviewed the live PR head, not just the commit in your note. Thanks
for reopening it with clean jdieselny authorship.

It is not ready to merge. At `4a28f7b`, GitHub reports a conflict with
current main. More importantly, the signed statement still says
`result.status: divergent`, with mismatches in 11 of 21 suites, while
the pin and generated public context say the Rust verifier passed all
331 vectors. That is the same evidence mismatch I flagged yesterday,
so I cannot approve the public 331-vector pass claim.

The schema reds are a separate live production-drift blocker involving
the Works Authority tables and functions. Vercel is blocked on team
authorization, and Strix did not run because the trial ended. None of
those changes the signed-result problem.

The honest choices remain: bring the verifier to a signed `verified`
result across the 331 pinned vectors and regenerate the public
surfaces, or keep this as valuable signed divergence evidence without
replacing the existing passing pin.

I also checked the PR scope. The GRACE prototype and mailbox audit
changes are not in #595, so I am treating them as separate, not
verified by this review.

Best,
Iman
